title: ESPD Instance Data — Part I
description: EXPERIMENTAL canonical instance-data model for Part I of the ESPD standard form: the actual data entered about the procurement procedure and the contracting authority. This models instance data only — it is deliberately independent of the form definition, UI, and XML serialization. Values that map to code lists are represented as bare codes for now.

partI.description: Information concerning the procurement procedure and the contracting authority or contracting entity.
partI.$comment.todo.cpv: TODO (not yet modeled): the procurement-project envelope — `objectType` (ProcurementTypeCode: services/supplies/works/combined) and CPV codes (procurement subject classification). CPV maps to ProcurementProject/MainCommodityClassification|AdditionalCommodityClassification/ItemClassificationCode (listID='cpv'), a Part I / procedure-level concern, NOT a criterion. Confirmed via a real Slovenian export (option (a): procedure-level ProcurementProject, no per-criterion CPV). Store bare codes and reference the external CPV authority list rather than embedding it. Not mandated by Regulation 2016/7 — an optional convenience feature. See docs/model-xml-mapping.md 'TODO: CPV codes' for the full finding and proposed implementation.

publication.description: How the procurement procedure is identified (PI01). Modeled as a single typed publication reference, mirroring UBL cac:AdditionalDocumentReference. The `type` is a DocrefcontentType code stating where the notice was published (TED, national/regional journal, ...); `identifier` and optional `url` are two facets of that same reference — not alternatives.

publicationReference.description: A single publication reference to the notice that identifies the procedure. Maps to one UBL cac:AdditionalDocumentReference.

type.description: DocrefcontentType code identifying where/what kind of document the notice is (e.g. TED_CN, NOJCN, ROJCN). Maps to cbc:DocumentTypeCode, which the ESPD Schematron BR-COM-10-03 makes mandatory.

identifier.description: The notice identifier/number. Maps to cbc:ID.

url.description: Optional URL locating the notice. Maps to cac:Attachment/cac:ExternalReference/cbc:URI.

allOf.$comment: ESPD Schematron BR-COM-10-01 (fatal): when the notice is a TED contract notice, the identifier must follow the Publications Office scheme YYYY/S NNN-NNNNNN.

contractingAuthority.description: Identity of the procurer (PI02). Aligned to espd:ContractingAuthority / epo:Buyer.

officialName.description: Official name of the contracting authority or contracting entity.

country.description: Country of the contracting authority, as a bare country code.

procedure.description: The procurement procedure itself (PI03). Aligned to espd:Procedure / epo:Procedure.

title.description: Title or short description of the procurement.

fileReference.description: The contracting authority's file reference number for the procedure.

procedureType.description: Type of procedure, as a bare code.

identifier.description: A structured identifier carrying both the value and the scheme it belongs to.

scheme.description: The identifier scheme (e.g. VAT, a national registration scheme).
